style: Say clearly and with calm focus, like an older student running the launch at a science fair
lines: Set Speed v and Height h0, then press Launch. Watch the curve it draws.
Each mission is one equation. Press Write it, pick a method and solve. Then launch to check.
Check the discriminant first. Type how many real answers it means, then the roots.
Your answer checks. Press Launch and watch the clock stop at your time.
Negative time is before launch. Pick the other answer.
No real answer. The ball never gets that high.
Choose the target height, then press Tidy to collect the terms.
Pick a method. Fill the boxes, then press Check work.
Type the time or times that fit the event. Then press Check answer.
Type both algebraic roots, then press Check roots.
Press Launch to replay, or choose another mission.
